repos_data.description: NobodyWho is an inference engine that lets you run LLMs locally and efficiently on any device.

A Go toolkit for building AI agents and applications across multiple providers. Unified LLM client, agent framework with handoffs, tool calling, streaming, structured output, MCP integration, and cost tracking.
Off Grid AI — private, on-device AI. Run open models (text, vision, image, voice) locally through one OpenAI-compatible gateway. No cloud, no accounts, no API keys.

The Swiss Army Knife of Offline AI. Chat, see, speak, and generate images on your phone or Mac — GGUF LLMs, vision, Whisper speech-to-text, Stable Diffusion, tool calling, and local-network servers. Runs on your CPU, GPU, or NPU. No account, no API key, zero data leaves your device.
Local AI app and inference engine for agents. Run open-weight LLMs locally — private, 100% offline on your computer. Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/8wGSsvmg4V
LocalAI is the open-source AI engine. Run any model - LLMs, vision, voice, image, video - on any hardware. No GPU required.
Very low latency speech to text, intent recognition, and text to speech, for building voice agents and interfaces
A lightweight, powerful framework for multi-agent workflows
Open-source real-time Voice AI infrastructure in Go. Stream audio via WebRTC or WebSocket, connect STT → LLM → TTS pipelines, and build scalable voice agents and conversational AI applications.
A WebRTC-native, audio-first conversational-AI framework for Go.
A local LLM workhorse that keeps a memory of your workday. On-device meeting notes, dictation, autocomplete, and recall for macOS. GPLv3.
Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models. Supports GGUF, MLX, Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, FLUX and more.
